hook: Did 3 Nord Stream pipelines rupture because of a state-sponsored sabotage mission in the Baltic Sea?

sections.voiceover: Did 3 Nord Stream pipelines rupture because of a state-sponsored sabotage mission in the Baltic Sea?

German prosecutors are now officially blaming Ukrainian state authorities for the Nord Stream pipeline explosions. Did Serhii K command the operation against the energy infrastructure between Russia and Germany?
However, Serhii K now faces trial in Germany for commanding the 2022 undersea pipeline explosions.
This legal proceeding opened four years after the undersea attack. The trial marks a major shift in energy security between Russia and Europe.
The trial of Serhii K will redefine energy security for Russia and Germany for years.
